content: {"episode_id":"ep-05062","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271), denied under CO-97 as bundled into another covered procedure. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. Cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the rhythm during these intermittent symptomatic events and guide further management."}
